messages.text: Rename this label to "Your first name"

agent.managerSummary:
The label lives in the Wix form builder, not in code — opening the form in your Wix dashboard and renaming it there will update the page automatically.
Dispatched to the /contact lane to rename the first name label to "Your first name".

lanes.name: /contact
lanes.summary:
The "First name" label on your contact page is set up in your Wix form builder, not in code — so I didn't change the code. You can rename it to "Your first name" here:

https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/f8f52542-3846-4a9d-8f11-2e0c40ccfa99/wix-forms/form/e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35

Once saved in Wix, the page will pick up the new label automatically.

AIDITOR_USER_OUTCOME: {"headline":"First name label is managed in Wix, not in code","bullets":["The contact form's field labels come from your Wix form builder, so changing them in code would be overwritten","Open the form in your Wix dashboard and rename First name to Your first name there","The page will show the new label automatically after you save in Wix"]}
